mintAuthority.summary: YUSD has independent native issuance on Ethereum and BSC. Each chain-local AegisMinting contract mints its YUSD against the native whitelisted order and single trusted-signer path; Ethereum's active mint cap is disabled and BSC's configurable cap is raiseable. The common 3-of-5 Safe owns the native YUSD, AegisMinting, and AegisConfig controls and can change minters and settings without a timelock. Avalanche and Katana are LayerZero V2 burn/mint representations; their adapter, OFT, peer, delegate, DVN, and cross-chain operator risks are assessed only in Bridge Risk.

controls.label: AegisMinting
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770366, YUSD.minter() returned this AegisMinting deployment. Its verified source shows the native mint(Order,signature) path requiring a whitelisted wallet, supported collateral, an unpaused mint path, the configured mint limit, and a signature from AegisConfig.trustedSigner(), followed by collateral transfer before yusd.mint(...). The separate depositIncome() reward-mint path is FUNDS_MANAGER-gated and remains native issuance evidence. The mintLimit exists but the current tuple read did not prove an active hard cap; an administrator can set mint limits, and SETTINGS_MANAGER_ROLE can pause native mint and redemption flows.

controls.label: Aegis admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770366 and BSC block 116345704, the common Safe remained owner/defaultAdmin of both YUSD tokens, both AegisMinting contracts, and both AegisConfig contracts. The current Safe API read returned five owners, threshold 3, no enabled modules, and the zero guard. The Safe can call YUSD.setMinter immediately and can change native mint limits, pause state, and trusted-signer/configuration settings through its owner, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and SETTINGS_MANAGER_ROLE powers. Native Ethereum minting remains unbounded because its active mint limit is disabled; BSC's configured limit is raiseable rather than a permanent supply ceiling.

controls.label: AegisMinting (BSC)
controls.capDescription: No on-chain supply ceiling; the BSC AegisMinting contract is the sole minter of the BSC YUSD token and its mint limits are administered by the same Aegis admin Safe that owns the Ethereum deployment.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 116345704, YUSD(0xab3dbcd9...).minter() = 0x02bf8f0e046F471709E578b1E633077096ce65CF and YUSD.owner() = 0x4Fe78eF65BD8EDDED480efaB030BA680646503c8. AegisMinting(BSC).yusd() = 0xAB3dBcD9B096C3fF76275038bf58eAC10D22C61f, .owner() = .defaultAdmin() = 0x4Fe78eF65BD8EDDED480efaB030BA680646503c8, and .aegisConfig() = 0xB9f1E8417ABaedF6Fd838212267cA8260c4ca9da. Both the token (4,903 bytes) and AegisMinting (20,949 bytes) read zero at the EIP-1967 implementation slot, so neither is a standard proxy. The verified native path requires the single trusted signer and collateral/order checks; BSC mintLimit() is configurable and not a permanent supply ceiling.

review.evidence: Native Mint Authority review refreshed for Ethereum block 25770366 and BSC block 116345704. Ethereum YUSD.owner() remained 0x4Fe78eF65BD8EDDED480efaB030BA680646503c8, YUSD.minter() remained AegisMinting 0xC4Df68e592245cA5202fE8b7C438d2b799820fc2, and the Ethereum AegisMinting path requires a whitelisted collateral order and the single AegisConfig.trustedSigner() 0xb28c97E348C3078fC1F6Fcc61b79c8a0DA35008e. BSC YUSD.owner() remained the same Safe, YUSD.minter() remained AegisMinting 0x02bf8f0e046F471709E578b1E633077096ce65CF, and BSC AegisMinting.owner()/defaultAdmin() and AegisConfig.owner() remained the Safe with the same trusted signer. Ethereum mintLimit() has periodDuration = 0 and maxPeriodAmount = 0; BSC has a 600-second, 210,000e18 configurable period limit, so the native economic cap remains unbounded and raiseable. The Safe is 3-of-5 with no enabled modules and a zero guard, can call YUSD.setMinter immediately, and can change native AegisMinting settings without a timelock; all four native deployments are non-proxy. The native review covers mint(Order,signature), depositIncome, native owner/default-admin/settings powers, and Accountable-backed continuous reconciliation with attestation-only supervision. LayerZero adapters, OFTs, peers, delegates, DVNs, and mintForCrossChain/burnForCrossChain are bridge capabilities retained under Bridge Risk and are not counted here.
